verdict_reason: The only change is a Javadoc edit that correctly drops the consignment contact, but the Javadoc it rewords still claims a commodity 'type' that does not exist and understates what party mapping copies.

todos.issue: The class Javadoc this PR edits is still untrue of toCopyDto: line 9 says commodity identity keeps 'type', but Commodity has no type field (Commodity.java:16-25 holds name, commodityCode, description, counts, species) and mapCommoditiesForCopy (lines 62-66) copies name, commodityCode and description only; line 10 says 'party addresses' are kept, but mapConsignmentParty (lines 40-45) also copies name, email and phone.
todos.fix: Must: every claim in the class Javadoc matches what toCopyDto copies and resets, or the Javadoc is gone (code-quality.md: a stale comment is deleted, not reworded). One way: drop 'type' from the commodity list and say 'parties (name, email, phone, address)' in place of 'party addresses', or delete the field-by-field lists and leave the one-line contract 'Maps a NotificationAggregate to a NotificationDto for copy-as-new', with NotificationCopyMapperTest as the record of what is kept.
